fact: Sudan's Minister of Communications and Digital Transformation, Adel Hassan Mohamed Al-Hussein, signed the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo) for the Sudanese government at the African Union building in Addis Ababa, and Sudan was to begin ratification steps at once.
title: السودان يوقع على اتفاقية الاتحاد الافريقي للأمن السيبراني وحماية البيانات الشخصية
